Buy gold online with Bullion Trading LLC and add a valuable asset to your investment portfolio. The 2.5 Gram PAMP Suisse Gold Rosa Bar is a renowned bullion product offered by PAMP (Produits Artistiques Métaux Précieux), the world’s leading bullion brand. As a trusted refiner and producer of precious metals, PAMP ensures the highest quality and purity.
This 2.5-gram gold bar contains 2.5 grams (0.0804 oz) of .9999 pure gold. It features a stunning Rosa design, making it a unique and desirable collectible piece. PAMP Suisse utilizes advanced technology, such as
Veriscan®

On the reverse side, you’ll find the PAMP Suisse logo, along with essential details like weight, purity, and a unique serial number. Each bar also comes with an assay card for added assurance.
